name: Readable texts read
notes: mw-kf4c: the reader (src/game/reader/reader.ts) records the first read of every note, inscription and book as entity:readables/<text id>.read, so the evidence.* facts and the logic events a text publishes (readable.read, and an event named by the text id) fire once and a save keeps it.

facts.description: Whether the player has read this text (set on entity:readables/<text id> by the reader on the first read; never reset). The first read writes the text's evidence.* facts and publishes readable.read and the text's own event.
